items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: He was there for a little while when I first came there, yeah. He’s a nice guy.

ctx.x: Yeah, Dinah, yeah. Dinah was there for a while. I called her — she was just getting ready to leave. She told me, she said, “Zeke,” she said, “I’m sorry, I’m so sorry that I have to leave.” She said, “You’re some piano player,” she said, “but I can’t contend with this man.”
And what about Joe Williams? I know he was with Hampton for a while but it might have been —
Yeah. He was there for a little while when I first came there, yeah. He’s a nice guy.
